trick: Paste docs vs let it fetch
source_note: Claude Code best practices list both: paste the docs, or give a URL and let Claude fetch it. Day 36's docs fixture (helpdesk-ai on ai@7.0.128, AI SDK 7, released 25 June 2026). With: the task's ai-sdk.dev pages pasted before the task (saved as markdown on 2026-10-06, docs/MANIFEST.json has URL, time and sha256; same text every run), no web tools. Without: 'Docs: <url>' lines for the same pages before the task, with WebFetch and WebSearch allowed. No MCP on either side. Same graders as day 36. Web calls per run come from the saved events (tricks/d36/count_calls.py). Both sides may also run `npm test` (allowed_tools_extra): in the pilot every run that tried to test reached for `npm test`, which the lab's tool list denies, and then stopped testing. 2026-10-06 decision (before any run): the fetch side's prefix is an explicit instruction, 'Read the library docs for this task before you start:' plus the same URLs, because with a bare 'Docs: <url>' Haiku opened the link in 0 of 8 pilot runs; the day measures pasted docs vs docs the agent fetches itself (WebFetch returns its own summary of the page). Docs copy saved 2026-10-06.

without.label: Told to read the docs URL (web fetch)
